audit.framing_9x16: Standard vertical stack with gameplay on top and streamer facecam on bottom, maintaining both active in frame.
audit.subtitle_craft: White bold centered sans-serif captions with outline, featuring emojis like crying face and peace sign next to text, timed to speech chunks.
audit.zoom_and_camera_work: Static framing with no dramatic zoom-ins or heavy camera movement, relying entirely on the visual of the gameplay opening and streamer reaction.
audit.sfx_and_music_craft: Minimalist audio approach focusing primarily on raw streamer voice and game sound effects with natural comedic reactions.
audit.comedic_timing_and_cuts: Starts with the streamer attempting to communicate in-game, building up to opening a chest and reacting with a high-pitched scream of 'almost almost', ending right on the payoff.
standout_techniques: Placing emoji reactions directly above or beside subtitle text for emotional emphasis
Stacking facecam directly beneath gameplay for a clean 9:16 layout
Keeping unedited raw voice audio during intense gaming moments
anti_patterns_to_avoid: Lack of dynamic zooms or camera reframing makes the edit feel slightly static
Simple static subtitle placement without word-by-word animation pop effects
